_about: Bond-shaped variation (List 35, #339): the bond channel of #337's drift, plus the end-of-life future read. Translated from the documented Chao happiness grammar: lifetime treatment sums VISIBLY on the body, and the end of a life reads the sum (the pink/grey cocoon SHAPE — loved toward continuation, neglected toward ending). The read machinery is built; what the outcome classes ARE is canon, open entire.
declarationJoin: marks are presentation only — any BATTLE consequence of bond remains an #180 declared row or it does not exist (#180's law untouched). From the other side, the marks are #180's visible-cue demand made continuous: the bond a row reads is the bond the audience has been seeing.

endOfLifeRead.contents: OPEN — canon entire: what continuation and ending mean in this world, what an ending leaves, whether the show ever stages one. Of the same class as #243's cast-aging slot. No end-of-life event is instanced for any individual by this package.
endOfLifeRead.fires: once, at the end-of-life moment; the resulting class is a fact other systems cite (#225 memorials = the place-side neighbour)
endOfLifeRead.inputs: lifetime bond pattern ONLY (#338 family 3 over the whole-life window) — not level, not wins, not value: how it was treated
endOfLifeRead.seat: beside #243's life-stage read (both lifetime derivations over #80's history)
endOfLifeRead.shape: the Chao cocoon shape: sustained-loved resolves toward the continuation class; sustained-neglected toward the ending class

keeperContext: bond facts are per-keeper (#338 family 6): a transfer (#168/#217) never zeroes the read — marks carry the history with people; #273's stolen time contributes to the look (drift), never to the heart (that is #287's)

classes: ease (sustained high bond): open bearing, unhesitating approach in #152's behaviours, rest taken near the keeper, groomed finished surface
ordinariness (the middle): NO mark — the engine's zero is a real class; the sheet shows plain
want (sustained low bond / recorded neglect): guarded bearing, startle in idle selection, distance kept, surface dulled within the palette fence — quiet margins, never wounds (damage is #287's)
marks.reReadability: marks are reads, not scars: sustained care re-reads want toward ease across a life with no forgiveness event; growth-moment settling preserves the life so far and the next settling re-reads the whole — a rescued Mochi is allowed to end up looking loved
